messages.subject: Operating on sequence file
parts:
Hi Saptarishi,
I would like to know that is there any way in RHIPE to read all the
the output files generated by the map-reduce job.

Reason being if i give the output folder then first directory inside
the output folder is _logs directory,
so if i something like this rhgetkey(key,"/out/blocks")

it throws the error that _logs is not a sequence file.
I tried giving wild characters like rhgetkey(key,"/out/blocks/part_*")
but this also doesn' work.


So is there any other way or i need to delete the logs directory and
then call the required functions.

Regards,
Sphinx
